themes.name: Web Slinger
themes.description: Midnight city, crimson glass and cobalt webs. Bold condensed headings, themed Veyra branding, angular control details, web timeline and an optional matching launcher icon.

themes.name: Halloween Nocturne
themes.description: Moonlit forest, pumpkin amber and gothic headings. Themed Veyra branding, sculpted controls, ember timeline and an optional matching launcher icon.

themes.name: Playtime Club
themes.description: An unofficial cartoon music party with Doraemon, Shin-chan and Oggy-inspired fan artwork. Rounded Fredoka headings, butter-yellow controls, mint bubbles, soft press feedback and a matching optional Veyra icon.

themes.name: Astral Tide
themes.description: Bioluminescent manta rays beneath a midnight ocean. Bold Space Grotesk headings, sea-glass mint controls, champagne starlight, custom waveform glyphs and an optional matching Veyra icon.

themes.name: Midnight Express
themes.description: Rainy night-train windows, warm amber light and coal-blue surfaces. Bold Rajdhani timetable-style headings, custom controls, a parallel route timeline and an optional ticket-waveform Veyra icon.

themes.name: Pumpkin Purr
themes.description: Cream ghost kittens, pumpkin lanterns and cocoa paper. Rounded Fredoka headings, soft corners, bubble timeline and an optional ghost-cat waveform icon.

themes.name: Sunset Crew
themes.description: Coastal violet coupes and honey sunset. Unofficial SpongeBob / Patrick fan art; characters belong to Nickelodeon / Paramount, no affiliation. Bold Rajdhani headings, road timeline and an optional sunset-waveform icon.

themes.name: Starry Spirits
themes.description: Gentle sheet ghosts under an original swirling teal-and-gold oil-painted sky. Space Grotesk headings, starlit timeline and an optional spirit-waveform icon.

themes.name: Analog Reverie
themes.description: Warm walnut, smoked olive, vinyl and a luminous swallow. Bold Manrope typography, restrained player details and an optional record-waveform icon.

themes.name: Petal Promise
themes.description: Ivory stationery, dusky pink tulips, satin bows and watercolor hearts. Ivory artwork over readable plum-rose controls, rounded Fredoka headings and an optional bow-waveform icon.

themes.name: Moonlit Herbarium
themes.description: Lavender wildflowers, ivory moths, a crescent moon and a small garden spirit. Space Grotesk headings, gold accents and an optional moonflower-waveform icon.
